prompts.name: 01-daily
prompts.prompt: Generate ONE standalone high-fidelity mobile UI mockup image, portrait 1024x1536, for Flamee, a Vietnamese couples connection app, feature Tiny Mission. This is a visual prototype only. Show one straight-on subtle thin graphite premium phone frame, entire device visible, balanced small outer margins on warm neutral studio backdrop; UI dominates image, no collage, no extra devices or external captions. Cross-platform native mobile feel. Consistent design bible for this series: background #EEECEA, warm ivory content #FFFCF8, coral primary #FF7158, peach accent #FCB76D, dark brown text #302924, secondary #70655D, subtle border #E6DDD3, muted sage for completion only. SF/system-like rounded sans with excellent Vietnamese accents, readable body 16px equivalent, titles 28px, large touch targets. Clean thoughtful restrained romantic design, warm matte surfaces, soft shadows, small product-specific illustrated flame/heart/gift motifs; no noisy decorative graphics, no gradients, no excessive nested cards. Root page title outside ONE large rounded warm-white content surface with soft shadow, all feature content inside; no subtitle or eyebrow below page title. Reusable consistent coral rounded buttons, understated outlined secondary buttons, tidy rows with dividers. Shared feature-local navigation tabs inside content surface: 'Hôm nay', 'Thành tựu', 'Đổi quà'. Main app navigation at bottom only on root screens, small icon-only pill with home, heart, centered plus, selected mission flag, profile; respect safe areas. Example couple names Linh and Nam. Shared wallet 1.250 points before redemption, after spending 800 balance 450. Daily exactly FOUR missions: one for Linh, one for Nam, two shared. Individual missions have owner and owner's self-check; shared requires each partner self-check, no approval workflow, no evidence uploads. Points only after required checks. No leaderboard, penalties, cash, countdown pressure, maps or game world. Reward products and scores are sample content; never imply actual delivery happened. Fanpage URL must be visibly placeholder 'facebook.com/<fanpage>' not a fabricated real account. SCREEN 1: root title 'Tiny Mission'. In single main content surface show local tabs Hôm nay selected, Thành tựu, Đổi quà. Compact wallet text 'Điểm của hai bạn' and '1.250' with small coral flame coin icon, gift shortcut. Section 'Nhiệm vụ hôm nay', '25 tháng 10' and thin daily progress '1/4 hoàn thành'. Four flat spacious task rows, fitting visibly: 1 photo motif 'Gửi một tấm ảnh hôm nay', owner 'Linh · Cá nhân', '+20 điểm', sage status 'Đã hoàn thành'; 2 message motif 'Nhắn một lời động viên', 'Nam · Cá nhân', '+20 điểm', status 'Chưa hoàn thành'; 3 video motif 'Gọi video 10 phút', 'Cả hai · Nhiệm vụ chung', '+40 điểm', small initials status 'Linh ✓   Nam ○'; 4 calendar motif 'Lên kế hoạch cuối tuần', 'Cả hai · Nhiệm vụ chung', '+40 điểm', '0/2 hoàn thành'. Each unfinished row has subtle swap icon and chevron with good hit target. Bottom within surface small link 'Cách tính điểm'. Warm approachable real app, no huge hero.
